title: Act on the Restoration of Honor of and Compensation to Victims of Samcheong Reeducation
title_original: 삼청교육피해자의 명예회복 및 보상에 관한 법률
full_text:
ACT ON THE RESTORATION OF HONOR OF AND COMPENSATION TO VICTIMS OF SAMCHEONG REEDUCATION

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Act is to promote the stability of the livelihood of persons who suffered harm in connection with Samcheong Reeducation or their bereaved family members, and to contribute to the advancement of human rights and national reconciliation, by taking measures necessary to restore their honor and by providing substantial compensation.

Article 2 (Definitions)
The terms used in this Act are defined as follows:
1. The term "Samcheong Reeducation" means purification education, labor service, or protective custody conducted pursuant to Martial Law Proclamation No. 13, issued on August 4, 1980 under Article 13 of the Martial Law Act (Act No. 69), or protective custody conducted pursuant to Article 5 of the Addenda to the Social Protection Act (Act No. 3286).
2. The term "victim of Samcheong Reeducation" means a person falling under any of the following items:
(a) A person who died or went missing as a result of Samcheong Reeducation;
(b) A person who sustained an injury as a result of Samcheong Reeducation (including a disease prescribed by Presidential Decree; hereinafter the same shall apply) and subsequently died from the aftereffects of such injury;
(c) A person who sustained an injury as a result of Samcheong Reeducation.
3. The term "bereaved family member" means a person entitled to inherit property under the Civil Act from a victim of Samcheong Reeducation (hereinafter referred to as a "victim") who died or is deemed to have died; provided, in the case of a missing person, a person who would have been entitled to inherit property under the Civil Act at the time the victim went missing shall be deemed a bereaved family member.

Article 3 (Committee for Deliberation on Restoration of Honor of and Compensation to Victims of Samcheong Reeducation)
① The Committee for Deliberation on Restoration of Honor of and Compensation to Victims of Samcheong Reeducation (hereinafter referred to as the "Committee") shall be established under the Prime Minister to deliberate and resolve the following matters concerning the restoration of honor of, and compensation to, victims or their bereaved family members:
1. Whether a person qualifies as a victim or a bereaved family member;
2. Payment of compensation and other benefits to victims or their bereaved family members;
3. Determination of the period of medical treatment and the degree of disability for victims who sustained injuries;
4. Restoration of honor of victims or their bereaved family members;
5. Support for victims or related organizations;
6. Other matters concerning the restoration of honor of and compensation to victims or their bereaved family members, as prescribed by Presidential Decree.
② The Committee shall consist of not more than 15 members, including a chairperson.
③ The Prime Minister shall commission or appoint members from among persons with extensive knowledge and experience and relevant public officials, as prescribed by Presidential Decree. The chairperson shall be elected by and from among the members.
④ The Committee shall complete its activities by June 30, 2015. In such case, the Minister of National Defense shall succeed to the affairs under the jurisdiction of the Committee. <Newly Inserted Mar. 27, 2015>
⑤ Matters necessary for the organization and operation of the Committee, other than those provided for in paragraphs ① through ④, shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree. <Amended Mar. 27, 2015>

Article 4 (Compensation)
① Bereaved family members of a victim falling under Article 2, subparagraph 2 (a) or (b), shall be paid compensation calculated by multiplying the victim's monthly salary, actual monthly income, or average wage (hereinafter referred to as the "average monthly wage" in this Article) at the time of the victim's death or disappearance by the remaining period during which the victim could have been employed, deducting intermediate interest by the simple discount method at the statutory interest rate, and adding interest at the statutory interest rate up to the date of the compensation decision.
② A victim falling under Article 2, subparagraph 2 (c), or the bereaved family members of such a victim, shall be paid the sum of the following amounts with interest at the statutory interest rate added to each amount up to the date of the compensation decision:
1. If the victim suffers a loss of income equal to the average monthly wage due to medical treatment considered necessary by the Committee, the amount of such loss during the period of medical treatment;
2. According to the extent of loss of working capacity due to physical disability, the amount obtained by multiplying the average monthly wage by the rate of loss of working capacity and the remaining period during which the victim could have been employed as calculated from the time of injury, after deducting intermediate interest by the simple discount method at the statutory interest rate.
③ Article 3 (6) and Article 3-2 (3) of the State Compensation Act shall apply mutatis mutandis to the remaining period of possible employment, disability grades, rates of loss of working capacity, and the deduction of intermediate interest by the simple discount method under paragraphs ① and ②.
④ If a victim who sustained an injury dies from a cause other than that injury, compensation shall be paid under paragraph ② as though the victim were still alive.
⑤ In calculating compensation payable to bereaved family members under paragraphs ① and ②, living expenses prescribed by Presidential Decree shall be deducted from the average monthly wage.

Article 5 (Medical Support Payments)
① A victim falling under Article 2, subparagraph 2 (c), who, as at the time this Act enters into force, continues to require medical treatment because of the injury, or requires constant nursing care or the use of assistive devices, shall be paid in a lump sum the costs of medical treatment, nursing care, and the purchase of assistive devices, as prescribed by Presidential Decree. <Amended Apr. 13, 2021>
② Article 8 of the Act on the Restoration of Honor of and Compensation to Persons Related to Democratization Movements shall apply mutatis mutandis to the persons eligible for medical support payments under paragraph ① and the standards for such payments. <Amended May 18, 2015>

Article 6 (Restrictions on Payment of Compensation, etc.)
If the Committee determines that a person received a substantial amount of compensation from the State before this Act entered into force in connection with a death or injury caused by Samcheong Reeducation, that person shall be paid only the difference between the total amount of compensation under Article 4 and medical support payments under Article 5 (hereinafter referred to as "compensation, etc.") and the value of the amount previously paid, recalculated by adding interest at the statutory interest rate up to the date of the compensation decision.

Article 7 (Rights of Bereaved Family Members)
Bereaved family members shall have the right to receive compensation, etc., in accordance with the provisions of the Civil Act concerning succession to property.

Article 8 (Applications for Compensation, etc.)
① A victim or bereaved family member who wishes to receive compensation, etc., shall apply in writing to the Committee for payment of compensation, etc., attaching relevant documentary evidence, as prescribed by Presidential Decree.
② An application for payment of compensation, etc., under paragraph ① shall be filed within one year after this Act enters into force.

Article 9 (Decision on Payment)
The Committee shall decide whether to pay compensation, etc., and the amount thereof within five months from the date it receives an application for payment of compensation, etc.

Article 10 (Service of Written Decisions)
① When the Committee decides to pay or not to pay compensation, etc., it shall serve an authentic copy of its written decision on the applicant without delay.
② The provisions of the Civil Procedure Act concerning service of documents shall apply mutatis mutandis to service under paragraph ①.

Article 11 (Re-deliberation)
① A victim or bereaved family member who objects to a decision made under Article 9 may apply to the Committee for re-deliberation within 30 days from the date an authentic copy of the written decision is served under Article 10.
② Articles 9 and 10 shall apply mutatis mutandis to re-deliberation and service under paragraph ①, respectively. In such case, "five months" in Article 9 shall be construed as "three months".

Article 12 (Payment of Compensation, etc.)
① An applicant who has been served with an authentic copy of a compensation decision and wishes to receive compensation, etc., shall apply to the Committee for payment of compensation, etc., attaching a written consent to the decision.
② Matters necessary for the procedures for paying compensation, etc., other than those provided in paragraph ①, shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 13 (Protection of Rights to Compensation, etc.)
The right to receive compensation, etc., may not be transferred, offered as security, or seized.

Article 14 (Exemption from Taxes)
No national or local taxes shall be imposed on compensation, etc., paid under this Act.

Article 15 (Requirement of Prior Decision, etc.)
① No lawsuit concerning payment of compensation, etc., may be instituted unless a decision has first been made by the Committee; provided, this shall not apply if five months have elapsed from the date an application for payment of compensation, etc., was filed.
② A lawsuit under paragraph ① shall be instituted within 60 days from the date an authentic copy of the written decision (including an authentic copy of a re-deliberation decision) is served.

Article 16 (Recovery of Compensation, etc.)
① The State shall recover all or part of compensation, etc., paid to a person in any of the following cases:
1. If the person received compensation, etc., by fraud or other improper means;
2. If compensation, etc., was paid in error.
② If a person obligated to return compensation, etc., under paragraph ① fails to return the amount concerned, it shall be collected in the same manner as the disposition of national taxes in arrears.

Article 17 (Investigation of Facts, etc.)
① For the examination of payment of compensation, etc., and restoration of honor, the Committee may hear testimony or statements from victims, witnesses, or persons for reference, conduct verification or investigations when deemed necessary, or request necessary cooperation from the heads of relevant agencies. In such case, the heads of relevant agencies shall comply with such requests without delay unless there is a compelling reason not to do so.
② Any person may submit materials or freely give testimony to the Committee in connection with the payment or recovery of compensation, etc., and shall not suffer any disadvantage on that account.

Article 18 (Extinctive Prescription)
The right to receive compensation, etc., under this Act shall be extinguished by prescription if not exercised for three years from the date an authentic copy of the decision on payment of compensation, etc., is served on the applicant.

Article 19 (Support for Related Organizations)
The State may, following deliberation and resolution by the Committee and within the scope of the budget, provide partial support for project expenses and other expenses of nonprofit corporations or organizations established for purposes such as commemorating victims.

Article 20 (Restrictions on Organization of Related Groups)
No person shall organize an association or conduct personal activities for profit under the pretext of supporting victims or their bereaved family members.

Article 21 (Deeming Members to Be Public Officials for Application of Penal Provisions)
Members of the Committee who are not public officials shall be deemed public officials for the purposes of applying Articles 129 through 132 of the Criminal Act.

Article 22 (Penalty Provisions)
① A person who receives or causes another person to receive compensation, etc., under this Act by fraud or other improper means shall be punished by imprisonment for not more than five years or by a fine not exceeding 50 million won. <Amended May 9, 2014>
② A person who violates Article 20 shall be punished by imprisonment for not more than three years or by a fine not exceeding 30 million won. <Amended May 9, 2014>
③ Any attempt to commit an offense under paragraph ① shall be punishable.

ADDENDA <Act No. 7121, Jan. 29, 2004>

This Act shall enter into force on the date six months after its promulgation.

ADDENDA <Act No. 12561, May 9, 2014>

This Act shall enter into force on the date three months after its promulgation.

ADDENDA <Act No. 13244, Mar. 27, 2015>

This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDA (Act on the Restoration of Honor of and Compensation to Persons Related to Democratization Movements) <Act No. 13289, May 18, 2015>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Amendments to Other Acts)
① and ② Omitted.
③ Part of the Act on the Restoration of Honor of and Compensation to Victims of Samcheong Reeducation shall be amended as follows:

In Article 5 (2), "Act on the Restoration of Honor of and Compensation to Persons Related to Democratization Movements" (the former title written without spaces) shall be replaced with "「Act on the Restoration of Honor of and Compensation to Persons Related to Democratization Movements」" (the revised title in statutory quotation brackets).

ADDENDA <Act No. 18005, Apr. 13, 2021>

This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
